# Security Policy

<!-- @public-start -->
If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/:github_org/:package_slug/security/advisories/new) or by email to [code@happenv.com](mailto:code@happenv.com). Please do not use the public issue tracker.
<!-- @public-end -->
<!-- @private-start -->
If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it by email to [code@happenv.com](mailto:code@happenv.com) instead of opening an issue.
<!-- @private-end -->
